explication: swift-transformers is a Swift library for using language models in apps, especially tokenization, Hugging Face Hub downloads, and CoreML inference and generation. A typical workflow loads tokenizer assets (from the Hub or local files), formats and tokenizes text or chat messages, runs a model to generate token IDs, then decodes them. The graph preserves the documented Hub, tokenizer, model, and generation capabilities. Some internal wiring is based on README and package-level evidence because the sampled source excerpts are partial.
